_known_wrong.package_json.causation_confidence_score: T0-06: 55 of the 100 points are hardcoded at the call site (days_between=1 -> temporal 100, distance_km=0.0 -> spatial 100). The magnitude term additionally scores an unmeasured NDVI drop as a measured 0.0, and phenology_flag=None is read as 'checked and passed' (90) rather than 'never checked'. Net effect: a request with no imagery at all scores 98/100, higher than one with a full optical pair.
_known_wrong.package_json.damage_severity_index.value: T0R-05: with no archive at all, _entropy_weights falls back to uniform 1/6 over six 0.5 midpoints, producing a confident-looking 0.5 from no historical evidence whatsoever. After the fix no indicator contributes and the score becomes null.
_known_wrong.weather_results[0].causation_confidence_: T0-06: same figure, as persisted. See the package_json entry.

_purpose: No historical archive for any indicator.

confidence_or_accuracy.note: No labeled training data available yet; this is a disclosed fallback formula, not a calibrated model prediction.

accuracy_statement: fAPAR and insolation are approximated from NDVI via a published linear relationship, not a dedicated fAPAR product (known limitation).

Component 2 features measured for this request: ndvi_deviation, rainfall_anomaly, temperature_anomaly, fapar_deviation, soil_moisture_deviation (5 of 17 declared). Features that could not be measured were omitted rather than defaulted.
Cloud/shadow-free coverage of the submitted geometry, after per-pixel masking — pre-event: 95% of field; post-event: 95% of field.

Yield loss = damage fraction × Harvest Index, using an assumed Harvest Index of 0.4 applied uniformly to all crops. This is a modeling assumption, not a crop-specific published value — the evidence request carries no crop type to select one by (modeling-approach.md §2).

Damage classification bands (negligible < 0.1 ≤ minor < 0.33 ≤ moderate < 0.66 ≤ severe) are a presentational convention configured for this deployment, not a sourced standard. The underlying damage fraction and its confidence are the figures to weigh.

excluded.spatial_alignment: the weather anomaly's spatial footprint was not computed
excluded.temporal_alignment: no break-point date — the drop's timing is unknown between acquisitions

package_json.disclaimer: This yield-loss estimate and Damage Severity Index are supporting evidence components only. They are NOT an authoritative or indemnity-grade determination and do not replace or blend with any Crop Cutting Experiment (CCE) yield determination (Constitution §4, FR-026).

evidence_inputs.detail: untrained placeholder formula, not a calibrated prediction

notes: No historical baseline was available for this geometry; anomaly-vs-history scoring was omitted (FR-023).

Causation confidence (46) was computed from 2 of 4 alignment terms, reweighted over those measured. Terms not measured: temporal_alignment (no break-point date — the drop's timing is unknown between acquisitions); spatial_alignment (the weather anomaly's spatial footprint was not computed).
